There are no signs of obfuscated URLs, suspicious network endpoints, or unauthorized code injection. The use of a GitHub patch from a known contributor (rheit) to apply a necessary fix (CMake minimum version) is common in packaging when upstream has not yet incorporated the change.

No executable commands, scripts, or runtime behaviors are present in this file — it is purely declarative metadata. As such, it poses no security risk and aligns with standard AUR packaging practices.
